title: Dungeon Degenerates: Hand of Doom
subtitle: Psychedelic dark fantasy adventure sandbox
loreSummary: You are degenerates, criminals, and lowlifes thrust into the grim, vibrant, and corrupt world of the Würstreich. Explore the dangerous sandbox, fight weird monsters, and decide the fate of the land as the Hand of Doom approaches.
keyFeatures: Persistent party development and danger levels
